scope: Actual Firebase Auth and Firestore plus the app adapter. No browser interaction. User-reported transitions are client-validated, not clinical assertions enforced by rules.

observations: Rules enforce ownership, metadata, size and version. They do not parse mutable JSON or attest clinical state. Decoder rejected an owner-corrupted record.
Default run tests quota transaction coupling and invalid bounds; it does not create 100 spaces. Use --quota-cap for actual saturation.
provenance: Deployed Firebase run executed by the owner; sanitized test labels, codes, counts and source hashes retained.
